# Heating Repair Request for Manchester Flat

## Polite but Firm Email Draft
**Subject:** Urgent: Repeated Heating Failure in Rented Flat

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing to follow up on the ongoing heating issue in my rented flat in Manchester.

I first reported the problem on **5 January 2026**, and I reported it again on **12 January 2026**. As of **20 January 2026**, the issue remains unresolved. The lack of heating is causing significant discomfort and is not acceptable for the property to remain in this condition.

Please arrange for the necessary repairs to be completed within the next **7 days** and confirm the expected repair timeline in writing. I would also appreciate written confirmation of **who will be responsible for the cost of temporary heaters** while the heating system is out of service.

I would be grateful if you could respond promptly with:
- the repair appointment date,
- the name of the contractor or engineer attending,
- a written timeline for completion,
- confirmation regarding temporary heater costs.

I hope we can resolve this quickly and professionally. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email Address]
